6:82.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh and worship none but Him Alone)
and confuse not their belief with Zulm
(wrong i.e. by worshipping others besides Allâh)
there is security and they are the guided.

6:83.text: And that was Our Proof which We gave Ibrâhîm
against his people. We raise whom We will in degrees. Certainly your Lord is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

6:84.text: And We bestowed upon him Ishâq
, each of them We guided, and before him, We guided Nûh
(the good-doers - see the footnote of V.9: 120)

6:85.text: , each one of them was of the righteous.

6:86.text: , and each one of them We preferred above the ‘Âlamîn

6:87.text: And also some of their fathers and their progeny and their brethren, We chose them, and We guided them to the Straight Path.

6:88.text: This is the Guidance of Allâh with which He guides whomsoever He wills of His slaves. But if they had joined in worship others with Allâh, all that they used to do would have been of no benefit to them.

6:89.text: They are those whom We gave the Book, Al-Hukm
, and Prophethood. But if these disbelieve therein
, then, indeed We have entrusted it to a people
(such as the Companions of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

6:90.text: They are those whom Allâh had guided. So follow their guidance. Say: "No reward I ask of you for this
. It is only a reminder for the ‘Âlamîn
